senses.gloss:
मोक्तव्य, अस्, आ, अम्, to be set free or released
or liberated; to be let go or given up or delivered;
to be flung or hurled, to be wielded, to be sent (as
a missile).

मोक मोक, अम्, n. (fr. rt. 2. मुच्), the cast-
off skin of an animal [cf. निर्-म्˚]; (ई), f., Ved. night.

मोक्तु-काम, अस्, आ, अम्, wishing to let go, de-
siring to shoot or cast.

मोक्तृ, ता, त्री, तृ, a releaser, liberator, deliverer,
rescuer, saviour; one who pays or discharges (a debt),
a payer.

मोक्ष् मोक्ष्, cl. 1. P. A. मोक्षति, -ते
(more properly to be regarded as an
anomalous Desid. fr. rt. 2. मुच्), to set free, liberate;
to free one's self from or wish to do so (A.); cl. 10.
P. (ep. also A.) मोक्षयति (-यते), -यितुम् (perhaps
to be regarded as a Nom. fr. मोक्ष below), to free,
set free, set at liberty, liberate, emancipate; to set
free from (with abl.); to detach, extract; to loose,
untie, undo; to wrest away, wrest from (with abl.);
to shed, cause to flow; to cast, hurl, fling.

मोक्ष, अस्, m. emancipation, deliverance, free-
dom, liberation, escape, release; release from worldly
existence, final emancipation, eternal bliss resulting
from the soul's final liberation and its exemption from
further transmigration; death; epithet of particular
sacred hymns conducive to final emancipation; de-
livery, discharge; the act of loosing, loosening,
untying, unbinding, undoing, solving, (प्रश्न-म्˚,
the settling of a question); acquittance of an obli-
gation; (in astronomy) the liberation of an obscured
planet, end of an eclipse, the last contact or separa-
tion of the eclipsed and eclipsing bodies; shedding,
causing to flow; the act of discharging, casting,
flinging, shooting; strewing, scattering; separating,
falling off, falling down; a species of tree (=
मुष्कक).
—मोक्ष-काङ्क्षिन्, ई, इणी, इ, de-
sirous of liberation or final emancipation.
—मोक्ष-
क्रिया-समाचार, अस्, आ, अम्, affording a method
for effecting liberation.
—मोक्ष-ज्ञान, अम्, n.
knowledge of the beatitude attained through final
emancipation.
—मोक्ष-तीर्थ, अम्, n., N. of a
Tīrtha.
—मोक्ष-दा, f., N. of a female ascetic.
—मोक्ष-देव, अस्, m. an epithet applied to
Hiouen-thsang.
—मोक्ष-द्वार, अम्, n. ‘gate of
emancipation,’ an epithet of the sun.
—मोक्ष-
धर्म, अस्, m. law or rule of emancipation.
—मोक्षधर्म-पर्वन्, अ, n. ‘section relating
to the law or rules of emancipation,’ N. of a section
of the twelfth book of the Mahā-bhārata, from
Adhyāya 174 to the end.
—मोक्षधर्मार्थ-
दीपिका (˚म-अर्˚), f., N. of a commentary on the
preceding section of the Mahā-bhārata.
—मोक्ष-
पुरी, f. ‘city of emancipation,’ an epithet of the
city of Kāñcī.
—मोक्ष-भाज्, क्, क्, क्, receiving
final emancipation.
—मोक्ष-महा-परिषद्, त्, f.
‘great emancipation-assembly,’ the great Buddhist
general council.
—मोक्ष-मार्ग, अस्, m. ‘path of
emancipation,’ N. of a Jaina work.
—मोक्ष-
लक्ष्मी-विलास, अस्, m., N. of a temple.
—मोक्ष-
वत्, आन्, अती, अत्, having final emancipation, con-
[]
nected with eternal bliss.
—मोक्ष-विंशक, अम्, n.
‘twenty verses on emancipation,’ epithet of the verses
Hari-vaṃśa 14348 sqq.
—मोक्ष-शास्त्र, अम्, n.
the doctrine of final emancipation.
—मोक्ष-सा-
धन, अम्, n. means of emancipation.
—मोक्षान्-
तरङ्-ग (˚ष-अन्˚), अस्, आ, अम्, nearest or next
to final emancipation.
—मोक्षोपाय (˚ष-उप्˚),
अस्, m. means of emancipation; a sage, saint, de-
votee (?).

मोक्षक, अस्, इका, अम्, (at the end of a comp.)
setting at liberty, freeing, delivering, emancipating;
(अस्), m. a species of tree; one who looses or unties
or sets free, a deliverer, liberator.

मोक्षणीय, अस्, आ, अम्, to be let go or liberated,
to be given up or resigned, to be disregarded or
neglected, (अ-मोक्षणीय, inevitable.)
मोक्षमाण, अस्, आ, अम्, setting free, liberating.
मोक्षयत्, अन्, अन्ती, अत्, setting free, liberating.

मोक्षयितृ, ता, त्री, तृ, one who frees or libe-
rates, a liberator, emancipator.

मोक्षाय, Nom. A. मोक्षायते, -यितुम्, to
become emancipated, tend to emancipation.

मोक्षित, अस्, आ, अम्, set free, let go, liberated,
allowed to be at large.

मोक्षिन्, ई, इणी, इ, striving after emancipation;
emancipated, redeemed.

मोक्ष्य, अस्, आ, अम्, to be set free or liberated;
to be saved.
